# Image sources and attribution
*2026-09-11 17:37 PDT*

All four images were generated with Google Gemini
(`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`) via the `gemini-image-generator` MCP
server on 2026-09-11, then resized to 1600px wide and converted to
JPEG at quality 85 with ImageMagick.

Usage: illustrative ambiance for the post 'Five Machines, One Object
Store, No Sync Daemon'. No people, logos, or readable text were
requested in any prompt. Generated imagery, no third-party rights
asserted.

The prompts continue the palette and metaphor family established in
the two preceding posts of the *Cloud Sync Migration* cluster: slate
blue and warm brass, with sealed containers, manifests, and now
depots and keys standing in for storage that is fetched rather than
replicated.
